drift_method.instrument: ap15_drift.py (committed beside this record), output ap15_drift_measured.json
drift_method.drift_lines: package copy vs SOURCE at 12a92ffa49^ (the commit before OG-fd-1), CRLF-normalised, added+removed; a module missing from the package contributes its source line count. This is FD2_DRIFT.json's drift_lines_without_drain_code and the order's table.
drift_method.drift_lines_vs_pre_fd2_pin: the same measure against 4c7e933975, i.e. FD2_DRIFT.json's drift_lines, which also carries the fd-1 drain code.
drift_method.control: Both columns reproduce FD2_DRIFT.json exactly on every family: 19/101, 282/359, 398/475, 298/375, and schwab 0 against the pre-fd-2 pin.

prior_state_read.code_sha256: aws lambda get-function-configuration, one resource each; all four unpinned values equal the fd-2 ask's 17:2xZ read, so nothing moved in between.
prior_state_read.s3: aws s3api list-object-versions per key, filtered Key== exact and IsLatest==true. Control: 41 versions under opal-assets/opal-assets-silver-, 7 keys with a latest version (the 7 silver_families), all five of these among them.
prior_state_read.pins: Only schwab carries OPAL_BUILD_COMMIT (a11240c01c). The other four read None, so their prior pin is UNPINNED and their prior identity is the CodeSha256 plus the package-path commit that built it.

families.note: The only family already running the per-family drain. Its package was byte-equal to source at the pre-fd-2 pin, so the rebuild ships exactly OG-fd-2: the drain record, plus the drain moving AHEAD of the conversion lanes so each lane's fold carries it. That reordering is a change of order and the ask discloses it.
Closest to drain-alone: 19 lines of non-drain drift, mirror_conversion.py 17 and silver_registry.py 2 (the third schwab master 08403355, inert to etf).

DRAIN-ONLY (A1 route (a)). Built from base_sha's package dir -- confirmed byte-equal to the DEPLOYED package first -- plus only OG-fd-1's and OG-fd-2's changes to mirror_conversion.py. git apply --3way refused ('does not match index': the patch preimage is the SOURCE blob, the index entry is the package copy, and those two differing is the whole premise), so the same 3-way was done with git merge-file: ancestor source at 12a92ffa49~1, ours the package copy at base_sha, theirs source at base_sha. Equivalence measured, not asserted: the range 12a92ffa49~1..b2538131ea holds exactly 2 commits over that file and the source blob at base_sha equals the one at b2538131ea (20bc5f08d5). rc=0, 0 conflict markers. RESULT: the package dir differs from base_sha by exactly one file, +85/-9 lines by git diff --numstat, stray lines 0 against the source drain delta -- AC1's own drain-only test. The grader's own denominator is 73 distinct added lines, because its lines() helper strips and de-duplicates: 85 raw = 73 distinct non-empty + 6 blank + 6 duplicate. +85/-9 is the figure to quote (CTO record note, A2).
